reason: I already have a rate card, a media kit and I invoice brands myself, and most of my South Bengaluru café collabs are barter anyway, so there's no cash for a 5% cut or payment reminders to chase. I'd maybe try the free version for scam checks, but I don't see why I'd pay for Pro.
